name: film-director
description: Direct a short film from a script with a coding agent: one skill for the filmmaking method, one plugin for the tools around it.

plugins.name: film-director
plugins.description: The filmmaking skill, all in one: script to film in four steps with a transitions library (video-film-maker), Blender proxy blocking for space, cameras and timing (blender-previz), and picking sound effects from Freesound (refsound).

plugins.name: film-crew
plugins.description: The tools around the skill, all in one: send job sheets to video and image models, view a run on a web page (showcase, node graph, progress), open each shot in ComfyUI as a workflow, and the hand-off formats they share.
